::: {.timeline}
::: {.timeline-node}
[**1961**]{.year}
[Political Behavior Archive founded by Dwaine Marvick]{.event}
:::
::: {.timeline-node}
[**1962**]{.year}
[Founding member, Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research (ICPSR)]{.event}
:::
::: {.timeline-node}
[**1977**]{.year}
[Becomes the Social Science Data Archive under the Institute for Social Science Research]{.event}
:::
::: {.timeline-node}
[**2014–15**]{.year}
[MOU transfers the Archive to UCLA Library (Dean Duranti / UL Steel)]{.event}
:::
::: {.timeline-node}
[**2018**]{.year}
[Data Science Center founded as the Archive's institutional home]{.event}
:::
::: {.timeline-node}
[**2017–2026**]{.year}
[Build-out: AI/ML, GIS, 3D and spatial curation, a research data repository, an open source program, a student workforce]{.event}
:::
:::

One person bridges nearly the whole modern era: **Jamie Jamison**, who transferred
with the Archive in 2014, is still on the DSC team today.
